one_line_description.value: Intercom is an AI-powered customer service helpdesk with an omnichannel inbox, ticketing and Copilot.
one_line_description.quote: Intercom is a fully-featured AI-powered helpdesk With an omnichannel inbox, AI-powered ticketing, and Copilot working alongside your human team

has_public_api.quote: To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.

api_type.quote: If you aren't able to find an existing app that solves the problem you're facing, you can build your own using our REST APIs and Canvas Kit framework.

api_breadth.value: Broad read-write REST/OpenAPI reference covering admins, conversations, contacts, tickets, AI content and other resources.
api_breadth.quote: - Activity Log Event Types: Schema: #/components/schemas/activity_log_event_type_list - Admin: Schema: #/components/schemas/admin - GET /me: You can view the currently authorised admin along with the embedded app object (a "workspace" in legacy terminology).

docs_url.quote: The Intercom Developer Platform is a suite of SDKs and APIs for building apps that connect with Intercom.

auth_methods.quote: Once you have a token, whether an access token or a token via the OAuth process, simply provide it as an `Authorization:Bearer` header in your requests

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Permissions let you specify exactly how your application needs to access an Intercom user's account.

access_model.quote: To develop a public app you will need to use a development workspace: sign up here to create your free account.

access_notes.value: Public apps require OAuth plus Intercom review to publish; private apps need only an Access Token and no review. A free but limited US-only development workspace is available, and private-app access to real workspace data requires a paid workspace.
access_notes.quote: These apps have access to other peoples' Intercom data, which means there are specific requirements in order to publish them, such as setting up OAuth and submitting to the Intercom team for review.

rate_limits.value: Default 10,000 API calls per minute per workspace and 25,000 per minute per workspace across all apps; public apps get 10,000/minute per app. Higher limits by request.
rate_limits.quote: Private apps have a default rate limit of 10,000 API calls per minute per workspace, shared by all private apps in the workspace, and 25,000 API calls per minute per workspace across all apps.

webhooks.quote: Webhooks are a way that you can access real-time notifications about events that happen in your Intercom workspace.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: We recommend creating a `[Staging]` or `[Dev]` app and a `[Production]` app to assist in the development process.

verdict_reason: Intercom provides a free self-serve development workspace and issues an Access Token as soon as an app is created, so credentials do not require sales contact; OAuth is also documented for public apps. The REST API is broad and read-write across admins, conversations, contacts, tickets and AI content, with documented rate limits, webhooks and a vendor-hosted MCP server. Public app distribution requires OAuth plus Intercom review, but private apps need no review, so the developer build path is easy; production workspace data requires a paid workspace.
open_questions: Official SDK languages could not be cited: the SDKs page (developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis/sdks-plugins) appeared in the search index but its text was not included in SOURCES; only the Ruby SDK is explicitly mentioned in captured pages.
API versioning and deprecation policy was not captured in SOURCES; the changelog and update-your-api-version pages were indexed but not fetched.
No community/third-party Intercom MCP servers were found in the evidence; GitHub and MCP registry checks returned none.
Development workspaces are documented as US-only and feature-limited; EU/AU development workspace availability is unclear.
Higher API rate limits require contacting Intercom via the messenger, although this does not gate base API access.
